title: Teeth are keys. Ear is vowel. Bounce and play. Blind is speak.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: TO CUT IS HER TEETH. KEYS LIKE KEYBOARD LETTERS. PIPE ORGAN PIANO STEVIE WONDER BLIND. THIS IS TO SPEAK. EAR IS VOWEL. FEEL IS BOUNCE AND PLAY.
ask: Teeth keys or not. Ear is vowel yes/no. One sound. Close.
